_comment: Hand-maintained index of Claude Artifacts (deliverables) built from the vault. Unlike the rest of the health page, this is NOT scanned — Claude has no API to enumerate a user's artifacts, so add new ones here by hand. Rendered ONLY on the private/full health dashboard (tools/vault_health.py, render_artifact); it is deliberately excluded from the public sanitized page because several titles name product surfaces. Keep titles here honest even if internal — this list never reaches the public URL.
